description: This file defines a mock class for the AudioOutputPort implementation, used primarily for testing purposes within the project. The class inherits from device::AudioOutputPortImpl and utilizes Google Mock to set up mock methods corresponding to the AudioOutputPort interface.

classes.name: AudioOutputPortMock
classes.description: A mock class inheriting from device::AudioOutputPortImpl, used for testing interactions with audio output port functionalities.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Mocks the method to retrieve the name of the audio output port.

methods.name: getMS12AudioProfileList
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of the list of MS12 audio profiles supported.

methods.name: getAudioCapabilities
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of the audio capabilities.

methods.name: isAudioMSDecode
methods.description: Mocks check if audio MS decoding is enabled.

methods.name: getEnablePersist
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of persist enable status.

methods.name: getHdmiArcPortId
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of HDMI ARC port ID.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Mocks check if the port is connected.

methods.name: getCompression
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of current compression level.

methods.name: getDialogEnhancement
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of dialog enhancement level.

methods.name: getSupportedARCTypes
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of supported ARC types.

methods.name: isMuted

methods.name: getAssociatedAudioMixing
